highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: At the University of Cincinnati (UC), you'll experience a mix of great academics with practical learning. Founded in 1819, UC is a public research university located in Cincinnati, Ohio. It offers you a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At UC, you'll be surrounded by a friendly and supportive student community. With over 600 student organisations, you’ll always have something to do. You'll have opportunities to attend games, participate in intramural sports, and engage in social events as well. Plus, the Student Wellness Centre offers resources for mental health, nutrition, and overall wellness.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Cincinnati offers a variety of on-campus housing options. These include residence halls or communities, suites, and apartments. The university also provides a platform where you can search for rental listings near the campus.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The university’s main library, Walter C. Langsam Library, offers you study spaces, computer labs, and a variety of research materials. You’ll also find specialised libraries, such as the Donald C. Harrison Health Sciences Library and the Archives and Rare Books Library, for specific disciplines and research.

Sports
On campus, you’ll find the UC's Campus Recreation Centre (CRC), which is a state-of-the-art facility with over 200,000 square feet of recreation space. It features a 50-metre lap pool, a leisure pool with a whirlpool, a six-court gymnasium, a suspended track, and more than 100 pieces of cardiovascular equipment.

Laboratory
You’ll also find many state-of-the-art laboratories across various disciplines. For example, the Brodie Complex, which includes specialised labs for molecular genetics, physiology, ecology, and more.

Cafeteria
UC has various dining options on campus. You can find several eateries across the campus, including the Tangeman University Centre (TUC), the DAAP Café, MarketPointe @ Siddall, and On the Green (OTG). The cafes also offer meal plans.
